name: @deepwork/desktop
description: Electron 壳：窗口、权限网关、内核子进程托管、IPC 通道
author: 深边AI

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env DEEPWORK_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run icon && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:dir: npm run icon && npm run build:renderer && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --dir
